descripcion:
The last night of 'after'.

Future self-continuity: people perceive and treat the future self differently from the present self, which can show up as valuing immediate gains over future ones; brain activation when rating the current versus future self predicted temporal discounting a week later (Ersner-Hershfield, Wimmer & Knutson, 2009, Social Cognitive and Affective Neuroscience, PMID 19047075). Small study on saving behavior.

alt: A short film with no voice over a night city by the sea. A pre-launch checklist: Gym membership checked (unused since Jan), Book checked (page 12), Call dad unchecked. A countdown reads 03:47:12 UNTIL THE LAUNCH and runs down to 00:00:00 turning green. A big yellow figure with white eyes and no hands watches; at 00:00 the first two items stay green, the empty Call dad box blinks, and a card says: Start with the empty box.
